senses.gloss: to pass a disease, quality, or condition from one person or thing to another
senses.example: The virus can transmit through close contact.

translations.th_TH: แพร่เชื้อ; สื่อต่อ

example_translations.zh_TW: 這種病毒可能透過近距離接觸傳播。
